Description: Sheer fabric opacity, micro-twill normal blending (RNM), volumetric absorption depth, and dual-sided thin-sheet subsurface scattering for ethereal organza petals and ruffles.

Inputs.Name: Normal
Inputs.Description: Macro fold normal vector in world space.

Inputs.Name: TwillTiling
Inputs.Description: UV tiling multiplier for micro-twill normal.

Inputs.Name: AbsorptionDepth
Inputs.Description: Mean Free Path (MFP) / absorption depth in millimeters.

Inputs.Name: SheernessAnglePower
Inputs.Description: Power exponent controlling angle-dependent opacity buildup.

Outputs.Name: PerturbedNormal
Outputs.Description: Reoriented Normal Mapped (RNM) blended normal vector.

Outputs.Name: SubsurfaceScatteringProfile
Outputs.Description: Mean Free Path (MFP) color profile for Substrate SSS.

Outputs.Name: FinalOpacity
Outputs.Description: Angle-modulated sheer opacity for Translucent Blend Mode.

Outputs.Name: Thickness
Outputs.Description: Normalized physical thickness for Substrate Thin-Slab.

Outputs.Name: SubstrateTranslucentBSDF_Inputs
Outputs.Description: Packed parameters for Substrate Translucent integration.
